section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the factor structure analysis of two measurement models (CEMS and IES-2) applied to a dataset with subsamples differentiated by gender (women and men). Model modifications were made to achieve satisfactory fit, including error covariance adjustments and item exclusions due to poor loadings and high residuals. The final models demonstrated adequate fit across the total sample and gender-specific subsamples.
